profile.aboutMissionBody: Cancer survivors who are returning to school, their parents, and their education team need a centralized, accessible platform that addresses the shared educational and social challenges of re-entry — in order to support a smoother transition back into the school environment.
profile.aboutMissionBodySheet: To facilitate a smoother transition from cancer treatment back to school in young cancer survivors and their support system in order to reduce anxiety, confusion, and feelings of isolation during reintegration
profile.whoStudentsDesc: Young cancer survivors navigating their return to school after treatment.
profile.whoParentsDesc: Families supporting their child through the re-entry process.
profile.whoStaffDesc: Teachers and staff creating an inclusive environment for returning students.

profile.feedbackDescriptionFull: Have a question or suggestion not covered above? Share it here. We collect responses to help shape future versions of SchoolKit — we won't be able to reply directly, but every submission is read and considered.

voice.q: How do I change the reading voice?

newProfile.q: How do I start a new profile / retake the survey?

role.q: How do I change my role?

topics.q: How do I change my topics of interest?

bookmark.q: How do I bookmark a resource?

offline.q: Can I use the app offline?

appearance.q: How do I switch between light and dark mode?

progress.q: How can I check my progress?

storyTime.q: How long will it take for my story to be approved?

storiesTab.q: What is the Stories tab for?

voice.a: Go to Profile → Voice. You can preview and select from several different voices for your companion.

newProfile.a: Go to Profile → Retake Survey. This will reset your role, topics, and preferences so you can go through setup again.

role.a: Go to Profile → Role. You can switch between Student, Parent/Caregiver, and School Staff at any time.

topics.a: Go to Profile → Topics. You can add or remove topics and the app will tailor content to your selection.

bookmark.a: Tap the bookmark icon on any resource card or detail page. Saved items appear in the Bookmarks tab.

offline.a: Yes! Tap Download All in your Profile to save resources for offline access. Bookmarks and previously viewed content are also cached.

appearance.a: Go to Profile → Appearance. You can choose Light, Dark, or follow your device system setting.

who.a: SchoolKit supports young cancer survivors and their families, caregivers, and school staff as they navigate the return to school after treatment.

progress.a: Go to the Profile tab to see your completed topics, downloaded resources, and bookmarks. Your activity is saved automatically as you explore the app.

storyTime.a: Stories are reviewed by our team before appearing in the community. This usually takes 1–3 days. You'll be able to see your story's status in the Stories tab.

storiesTab.a: The Stories tab is a community space where users can share their own life experiences related to the school re-entry journey. You can post anonymously or with your name — it's up to you.
